context: A uni student and a teen friend pick study weekends
purpose: Teach: 九月/八月/十月/十二月/下旬/起床/祝日/恒例

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ねえ、勉強合宿の週末、どこにするか決めようよ。八月はバイトで全然動けないんだ。
lines.en: Hey, let's decide which weekends for the study camp. I can't move at all in August because of work.
lines.style: Casual university student tone, friendly and planning-focused with a slight complaint.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ九月はどう?学校もまだ余裕あるし、九月の下旬なら祝日もあるよ。
lines.en: Then how about September? School is still chill, and late September has a holiday too.
lines.style: Bright teenage suggestion, helpful and quick to offer ideas.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 下旬かあ、いいね。祝日が絡むと宿の値段上がるけど、三連休ならガッツリやれる。
lines.en: Late month, huh, nice. Hotel prices go up around holidays, but a three-day weekend means serious study time.
lines.style: Thoughtful weighing of pros and cons, casual male university speech.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私、朝弱いから起床時間だけは緩めにしてほしいな。八時起きとかにしよ?
lines.en: I'm bad in the mornings, so please go easy on the wake-up time. Let's make it eight or so?
lines.style: Pleading teenage girl tone, slightly whiny but cute about her weakness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解。あと十月の体育の日あたりに第二回もやらない?年末の十二月は無理だろうし。
lines.en: Got it. Also, want to do round two around October's sports day? December year-end won't work anyway.
lines.style: Forward-planning, organizer-style speech with practical reasoning.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 十月いいね!紅葉も見たいし。十二月はうち、毎年恒例の家族旅行があるから絶対無理。
lines.en: October sounds great! I want to see the autumn leaves too. December I always have our annual family trip, so totally impossible.
lines.style: Enthusiastic teen, mixing excitement about scenery with family obligations.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 恒例行事か、いいなあ。じゃあ九月下旬と十月の三連休で確定。カレンダー送るね。
lines.en: An annual tradition, that's nice. So late September and October's three-day weekend it is. I'll send the calendar.
lines.style: Warm, decisive wrap-up by the older planner, slightly envious but cheerful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがと!起床時間優しくしてくれたら、ちゃんと予習してくよ。約束!
lines.en: Thanks! If you're nice about the wake-up time, I'll definitely do my prep beforehand. Promise!
lines.style: Playful teenage bargaining, cheerful and committed at the same time.
